description: `gitIgnoredAuthors` names the address Phoebe commits under on this repo: the noreply identity of the account whose token it runs on. Without it, Renovate treats a branch Phoebe pushed a changeset to as edited by someone else and stops refreshing it. If Phoebe moves to another identity (a GitHub App, a `gitIdentity` in the config), this address moves with it.

`minimumReleaseAge` matches the gate pnpm 11 applies by default: `vp install` refuses any package published less than 1440 minutes ago, and this repo sets nothing to relax it. Without the same number here Renovate resolves a version the moment it is published, CI fails on the age check, and the PR needs a manual retry a day later (#684).

The dogfood image bakes the pnpm that package.json's `packageManager` pins, as `ARG PNPM_VERSION` in `.phoebe/container/Dockerfile`, so a work unit can't rewrite it (#780). The custom manager finds that ARG, and the `pnpm` group moves it in the same PR as `packageManager`; `src/container-image.test.ts` fails if the two drift.

packageRules.description: Only a runtime dependency bump is a line a consumer would notice, so every other kind opens already labelled and never trips the changeset gate (#655). Phoebe's checks kind writes the changeset for the ones that are left.
The non-npm managers in this repo: CI workflows, the pinned Node version, the container images. None of them changes anything a consumer of phoebe-agent installs.
One PR for package.json's packageManager and the dogfood Dockerfile's PNPM_VERSION, which must stay equal. Neither reaches a consumer.
